profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website presents Claude as its AI, which the company describes as built for problem solvers, for tackling complex challenges, analyzing data, writing code, and thinking through hard work.

The company's tracked products are Claude, a general LLM assistant; Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls; Claude Code, described as agentic coding with source-code exposure; and Computer Use, a computer control agent for desktop automation with system access and high-privilege operation risk. An MCP server is also listed under the name ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic, described as an LLM orchestration agent.

Litigation involving Anthropic appears across several courts: the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and district courts in Vermont, Hawaii, Delaware, the Northern District of California, and the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Named matters include Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC; Brunell v. Anthropic PBC; Gribble v. Anthropic PBC; Haugland v. Anthropic PBC; Patel v. Anthropic, PBC; Smith v. Anthropic, PBC; Pascual v. Anthropic, PBC; University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC; Grossinger v. Anthropic, PBC; Shakespeare v. Anthropic PBC; and Kahn v. Anthropic PBC. California accounts for 270 of the matters listed.
